mapper.sql: task_id, house_id, operator_id, entry_type, source_rabbit_id, source_cage_id, source_row_code, status, revision, sale_time, total_weight, unit_price, customer, remark, request_id, sale_order_id, snapshot_time, completed_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into outbound_tasks (task_id, house_id, operator_id, entry_type, source_rabbit_id, source_cage_id, source_row_code, status, revision) values (#{taskId}, #{houseId}, #{operatorId}, #{entryType}, #{sourceRabbitId}, #{sourceCageId}, #{sourceRowCode}, #{status}, #{revision})
mapper.select: select from outbound_tasks where house_id = #{houseId} and operator_id = #{operatorId} and task_id = #{taskId}

select from outbound_tasks where house_id = #{houseId} and operator_id = #{operatorId} and status in ('SELECTING', 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION') and update_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day) order by update_time desc limit 1
mapper.update: update outbound_tasks set status = #{status}, revision = revision + 1, sale_time = #{saleTime}, total_weight = #{totalWeight}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, customer = #{customer}, remark = #{remark}, snapshot_time = case when #{status} = 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION' then now() else snapshot_time end, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and operator_id = #{operatorId} and task_id = #{taskId} and revision = #{revision} and status in ('SELECTING', 'WAITING_CONFIRMATION')

update outbound_tasks set status = 'COMPLETED', request_id = #{requestId}, sale_order_id = #{saleOrderId}, completed_time = #{completedTime}, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and operator_id = #{operatorId} and task_id = #{taskId} and request_id = #{requestId} and status = 'SUBMITTING'
